workarounds.symptom: [Bug] 继承旧历史的会话因 subagent/catalog 被误判为 session-related，无法删除
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(runtime): ignore inherited relationships when deleting forks. Target files: runtime/session-deletion/core.mjs, runtime/tests/session-deletion-inherited.test.mjs. 普通fork继承源会话的catalog/team记录，被完整历史扫描误认成自身关联工作，返回session-related。现在只扫描严格reader已验证的当前事件后缀，修复#705明确要求的继承误判。 (Ref: https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-Go/pull/955)
